fusions.name: Tremor Down the Line
fusions.desc: Sends a tremor down a line into the first enemy it meets, which deals 28 damage and bursts across every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that, with a 50% chance to leave each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Thundering Rush
fusions.desc: Charges through a cone out to 5 tiles, which deals 12 damage to everything caught in it, knocks each 3 tiles back and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Along the Guylines
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Tremor
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover sends a tremor that deals 7 damage to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. Once every 4 seconds.
